# CountBadge

A small number for pending items, such as unread notifications.

```tsx
import { CountBadge } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- On an icon button or a tab to show how many items need attention.
- Above `max` it shows "9+"; at zero it renders nothing.

## When not to

- As a status: use Badge.
- For large figures or measurements: show the number as text.

## Examples

### Counts

Above `max` it shows "9+". At zero it renders nothing, unless `showZero` is set.

```tsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-4">
  <CountBadge count={3} />
  <CountBadge count={12} />
  <CountBadge count={0} />
  <CountBadge count={0} showZero />
</div>
```

### Neutral and danger

Red marks notifications that need attention. The number is what carries the meaning; the colour only adds urgency.

```tsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-4">
  <CountBadge count={4} />
  <CountBadge count={4} tone="danger" label="4 notificaciones sin leer" />
</div>
```

### With a spoken label

When the number stands alone, `label` says what it counts.

```tsx
<CountBadge count={5} label="5 mensajes sin leer" />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` (required) | `number` |  |  |
| `tone` | `CountBadgeTone` | `'neutral'` | `danger` is red, for notifications that need attention; `neutral` is ink. The number still carries the meaning. |
| `max` | `number` | `9` | Above this the badge shows "max+" (for 9: "9+"). |
| `showZero` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders a zero instead of nothing. |
| `label` | `string` |  | What the number counts, spoken instead of the digits ("5 mensajes sin leer"). Without it the number is read as plain text. |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **The count must be spoken:** when the badge sits on a button, put the count in the button's name ("Notificaciones, 2 sin leer") and hide the badge. Standing alone, pass `label` so the number says what it counts.
- Number and background are 4.5:1 in both modes.

## Content

- Numbers only. Don't use it for text.
